source_resolution: Legacy ~/.config/slide-studio/location.json points to /Users/aki/Slides. The legacy repository bundled templates did not reflect the user-maintained themes actually used by the old app.
user_request: Use the themes used by the old app, including the undecorated level-two headings.
verification: Bundled default heading ::before and ::after content are none, heading color is rgb(34,77,145); direct text color editing, undo and redo remain covered. Existing customized workspaces retain their custom themes.
